title: Test Generation Agent
description: Analyze coverage gaps and generate comprehensive test suites for your code.

unit.placeholder: Select a file for unit test generation

userStory.label: User Story
userStory.placeholder: Describe the user story or scenario...

description.label: What should this code do?
description.placeholder: Describe the behaviour to implement. Example: a function that calculates the total price of a cart including taxes and discounts, handling empty carts and negative quantities.

filePicker.selectFile: Browse and select a source file...

errors.noFile: Please select a file to analyze
errors.generic: An error occurred during test generation

auth.title: The AI provider rejected your credentials
auth.hint: Open Settings → Providers and re-authenticate the active provider. If you sign in with a Claude subscription, your session may simply have expired.

rate_limit.title: Rate limit reached
rate_limit.hint: The provider is throttling requests. Wait a moment and try again, or switch to another account or provider in Settings.

quota.title: No credit left on this account
quota.hint: The provider accepted the request but refused to bill it. Check your plan or billing status, then try again.

network.title: The provider could not be reached
network.hint: Check your internet connection, and any VPN or corporate proxy between you and the provider.

timeout.title: The provider took too long to answer
timeout.hint: Large source files make the model slower. Try again, or generate tests for a smaller file.

provider_unavailable.title: The provider could not be started
provider_unavailable.hint: The CLI or Python dependency behind the selected provider is missing or not on PATH. Check Settings → Providers and your local installation.

empty_response.title: The provider returned nothing
empty_response.hint: The request was accepted but produced no text. This usually means the model refused the prompt or the response was cut short — try again, or pick another model in Settings.

file_not_found.title: The source file could not be read
file_not_found.hint: Check that the file still exists, is not empty, and is UTF-8 text rather than a binary.

write_failed.title: The test file could not be written
write_failed.hint: The tests were generated but not saved. Check the folder's permissions and free disk space, then copy the code above before retrying.

parse_failed.title: The provider's answer could not be read
parse_failed.hint: The model replied with something other than the expected JSON. Trying again usually resolves it; a more capable model resolves it more reliably.

invalid_input.title: Something is missing from the request
invalid_input.hint: Fill in the highlighted field and start the generation again.

backend_missing.title: The WorkPilot AI backend was not found
backend_missing.hint: The Python backend that runs the generator is missing from this installation. Reinstall the app, or run it from the repository so apps/backend is present.

runner_crashed.title: The generator stopped unexpectedly
runner_crashed.hint: The generator process died before it could report anything. The technical details below carry the reason it printed on the way out.

no_output.title: The generator finished without producing tests
no_output.hint: The process ran to completion but wrote nothing. Check that the source file is readable and that your provider is authenticated in Settings.

unknown.title: Test generation failed
unknown.hint: Open the technical details below for the raw error. Trying again is safe — nothing has been written to your project.
